parsed.summary: Router r3 acts as a gateway connecting the DMZ and sensors segments to the client-side networks via a link to r2. It forwards traffic between the client segments (10.0.1.0/24, 10.0.2.0/24, 10.0.99.0/24) through the eth1 interface connected to r2. It also isolates sensor traffic from client traffic by dropping packets from the sensors segment to the client segments.

interfaces.name: eth1
interfaces.role: gateway for client-side segments via link to r2

static_routes.purpose: forward traffic from client segment 10.0.1.0/24 via eth1 to r2
forward traffic from client segment 10.0.2.0/24 via eth1 to r2
forward traffic from client segment 10.0.99.0/24 via eth1 to r2
